config.title: Fishing Assistant
config.option.auto_cast.description: Cast again when the assistant is ready and fishing can safely continue.
config.option.auto_hook.description: React when a fish bites without requiring manual input.
config.option.auto_minigame.description: Control the fishing bar while a normal minigame is active.
config.option.auto_close.description: Confirm the caught-fish popup when it is safe to continue.
config.option.auto_treasure.description: Collect items from the fishing treasure menu using the configured inventory policy.
config.option.auto_trash.description: Remove newly acquired items that match the configured junk rules.
config.option.trash_fish: Allow fish to be treated as junk
config.option.trash_fish.description: Let the junk rules include fish at or below the configured value threshold.
config.option.auto_eat.description: Select food from this player's inventory when energy reaches the configured threshold.
config.option.eat_fish.description: Permit automatic food selection to consume fish from this player's inventory.
config.option.attach_bait.description: Attach preferred bait from this player's inventory when the rod can use it.
config.option.spawn_bait: Spawn bait when none is available
config.option.spawn_bait.description: Create the preferred bait when automatic attachment cannot find any. This is a cheat option.
config.option.attach_tackle.description: Attach preferred tackle from this player's inventory when the rod has an empty slot.
config.option.spawn_tackle: Spawn tackle when none is available
config.option.spawn_tackle.description: Create preferred tackle when automatic attachment cannot find any. This is a cheat option.
config.option.infinite_bait.description: Prevent the assistant's fishing workflow from consuming equipped bait.
config.option.infinite_tackle.descriptio: Prevent the assistant's fishing workflow from consuming tackle durability.
config.option.instant_bite.description: Remove the normal wait before a fish bites after casting.
config.option.always_perfect.description: Treat completed fishing minigames as perfect catches when supported.
config.option.max_fish_size.description: Use the maximum size roll for caught fish when supported.
config.option.instant_treasure: Collect treasure during the minigame instantly
config.option.instant_treasure.descripti: Complete treasure-bar progress immediately when a treasure target appears.
config.option.fish_preview.description: Show information about the current fishing target while the minigame is active.
config.option.fish_name.description: Include the current fish's name in the preview.
config.option.show_treasure.description: Include fishing treasure information in the preview.
config.option.uncaught_fish.description: Allow preview details for fish this player has never caught.
config.option.legendary_fish.description: Allow preview details when the current target is legendary.
config.option.enchant_auto_hook.descript: Temporarily add Auto-Hook to the equipped fishing rod when supported.
config.option.enchant_efficient.descript: Temporarily add Efficient to the equipped fishing rod when supported.
config.option.enchant_master.description: Temporarily add Master to the equipped fishing rod when supported.
config.option.enchant_preserving.descrip: Temporarily add Preserving to the equipped fishing rod when supported.
config.option.remove_enchantments.descri: Remove enchantments added by the assistant when the fishing rod is no longer equipped.
config.status.defaults_loaded: Defaults loaded. Select Apply to save them.
config.status.save_failed: The configuration could not be saved. Check the SMAPI log.
